normative_extracts.spec_section: RFC 9111 Section 4.1: Calculating Cache Keys with Vary
normative_extracts.quote: When a cache receives a request that can be satisfied by a stored response that has a Vary header field, it MUST NOT use that stored response unless all selecting header fields match.

normative_extracts.spec_section: RFC 9211: The Cache-Status HTTP Response Header Field
normative_extracts.quote: The Cache-Status header field conveys how caches handled a request, including hit/miss state and time-to-live.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Computes a deterministic tuple key at CDN edge PoPs to serve shared responses, where unstripped query parameters or broad Vary headers fragment hit ratios.

production_failures.symptom: CDN cache hit ratio collapses below 10% during ad campaigns
production_failures.root_cause: Marketing links append unique ?fbclid= or ?utm_source= query parameters that were included in the CDN cache key.
production_failures.mitigation: Strip tracking query parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid) from the CDN cache key normalization rule.

production_failures.symptom: Logged-in user A sees user B's personalized HTML dashboard
production_failures.root_cause: Edge CDN cached a response containing Set-Cookie or user-specific HTML because Cache-Control: public was set without Vary: Cookie or private.
production_failures.mitigation: Mark personalized responses Cache-Control: private, no-cache and strip Set-Cookie from any shared edge-cacheable route.
